text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer, is that...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thinking it would make a nice snack for 
Still in Love, I baked some simple 
cupcakes I saw in a video and brought them 
along.
choice_data_list:
It should have turned out delicious... I 
think

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
My... hehe. Please have more confidence in 
yourself.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
However, are you sure...? Giving cupcakes 
that turned out so delicious to me...
choice_data_list: That's exactly what I made it for.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...F-For me...?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(You knew... that I love sweets...? And 
you went out of your way just for that...? 
Thinking... of me...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(...Ah, no...! I was so happy I almost 
shouted out loud... I need to calm down 
and convey my feelings properly...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I... I'm so, so happy. Truly... I really 
am.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much. I shall savor and 
treasure this...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... It's truly delicious. The 
sweetness spreading through my mouth feels 
so gentle and comforting—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...I am savoring the aftertaste. Hehe... 
so blissful...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love took a bite of the cupcake 
and smiled at me, saying, "It's 
delicious." ...She looked so happy.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... It's so delicious... I feel like 
I've been eating... a little faster than 
usual... fufu.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
N-No... I can still eat... um, I want to 
eat it. I don't... want to leave anything 
behind...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There are still plenty of cupcakes left on 
the table. It feels like a bit too much to 
eat all in one go, but...
choice_data_list: I'm so happy you ate it all.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Really...?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
W-Well then, I shall chill it in the 
fridge and save it for later. I look 
forward to tasting it chilled, as well...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... A cupcake filled with your 
heartfelt feelings...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I must write my name on it... so that no 
one takes it away...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: I'm the one... who's happy, really.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"Bite by bite... I will cherish every 
chew... and savor every last bit..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Because these cupcakes were made with your 
precious feelings poured into them...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With an enraptured look on her face, Still 
in Love enjoyed the cupcakes lined up 
across the table.
